title: SKE Bar Apple Peach Prefilled Vape Pod
description: This Apple Peach pod for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit combines crisp Apple with soft, juicy Peach for a smooth, well-rounded vape. The blend of tart Apple and mellow Peach strikes a perfect balance between fresh and fruity, ideal for fans of light, orchard-style flavours. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt and mesh coil tech for a consistently smooth and flavour-rich MTL vape. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
